verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant that users message to delegate tasks. Its docs show it acting across connected apps, drafting emails, scheduling meetings, setting reminders, building and deploying websites, and creating charts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Poke is your AI assistant that lives in Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, and RCS.
Once connected, Poke can access information and perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation.
Calendar - Schedule meetings and check your availability
Poke can also create and deploy websites for you at yourname.poke.com.
Poke can now bring in real people to take on tasks with a human touch - restaurant reservations, phone calls, placing orders, booking rides, and more.
